capabilities: Sync the vault with a GitHub repository via ribbon button or command
Pull remote changes before pushing local ones
Commit all local changes with a timestamp message
Automatically detect the current git branch
Store the GitHub PAT securely outside the vault
extras: Only manual installation is described; the vault itself must already be a git repository and Git must be installed. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync options don't cover keeping a vault backed up and in sync through a GitHub repository.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that syncs your vault with a GitHub repository in one click.

summary: Git-based sync tool that pushes and pulls the whole vault to a GitHub repository with one click.
